baseline.effects: No cross-file transaction/rollback; rerun after repairing source/filesystem.

frozen_transition.evidence_rule: This is a planned responsibility mapping. The receiver must attach observed test/review evidence or an explicit supported N/A rationale. Broad source overlap is not row-specific coverage proof.

accepted_task.title: Stage and validate owned generated outputs before replacement

coordination_links.reason: Validated generated candidate consumed by whole-program qualification.

implementation: Inventory each generator owned output root and late validation boundary; distinguish whole-root generation from projections mixed with handwritten files.
Render into a fresh owned staging tree, validate complete content/schema/links there, and replace only owned outputs using the platform-appropriate safe promotion procedure.
For mixed/manual trees where one atomic rename is impractical, use explicit manifest/staging validation and failure-as-unusable gates without deleting handwritten files.
Fix Pagefind old-output removal before rename; retain prior complete index until promotion succeeds or expose failed output as unusable.
Ensure package/release consumers reject failed/incomplete generation rather than trusting leftover files; rerun deterministic canonical input safely.

acceptance: Injected render/validate/rename failure preserves previous complete owned output or clearly blocks consumption of a partial projection.
A clean rerun converges to the same canonical output; successful package uses one complete generation.
rejection_and_failure: Foreign/symlinked target root, mixed ownership, failed rename and incomplete output cannot be marked build-ready.
concurrency_and_interruption: Two builders targeting same root serialize/refuse safely; consumer never observes an advertised ready mixture.
Interrupted staging cleanup affects only owned temporary paths.

acceptance: Targeted generator fault tests and complete build/packaging verification for changed output owners.
Explicit manifest of handwritten versus generated surfaces.
rollback: Restore previous complete output; keep canonical sources and owned staging for diagnosis when needed.
Never wipe a mixed output root to make rollback easy.
accepted_task.evidence_rule: PLANNED is an instruction, not implementation or qualification. Read the owner ledger for every preserved invariant, test command, migration rule and source qualification.

conclusion: Only the historical direct-write/no-transaction/no-rollback guarded tuple is obsolete. The I/O failure event, possible partial projection and four introduced failure/recovery runtime obligations remain applicable.
limits: Source conformance only, no runtime execution or qualification.
Private preparation; canonical ledger, proofs, progress, Git index and refs untouched.
No status promotion and no claim that historical behavior passed current tests.
